newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on ample liquidity.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed lower on Wednesday as ample liquidity, especially in the short-term money market, improved buying sentiment, brokers said.
The three-month CDs also fell on fewer new issues, while the overnight call rate edged down because the release of money from the state budget increased liquidity in banks, they said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.47 pct from 12.50 on Tuesday
* 3-mth CDs close at 13.05 pct from 13.15 pct
Brokers said the release of money from the state budget for tax returns helped increase liquidity in the short-term money market.
The overnight call rate fell to 12.98 percent from 13.20 percent, while the three-month CDs also dropped to 13.05 percent from 13.15 percent on fewer new issues, they said.
